name: llx
description: llx in Claude Code: a search of the code by what a question means (llx grep), fast cheap judgments on long or many texts (llx decide), and a subagent that hands bulk reading to llx on any provider and model

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.title: OpenRouter API key (optional)
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: For llx grep and llx decide, which run on OpenRouter's decision model, and for llx itself where it thinks on OpenRouter. Leave it empty to use the key llx already keeps (/login in llx) or the environment's. Kept in the system keychain.

LLX_PROVIDER.title: Provider for the llx subagent (optional)
LLX_PROVIDER.description: openai (a ChatGPT sign-in) or openrouter. Leave it empty for the one you chose with /login in llx.

LLX_MODEL.title: Model for the llx subagent (optional)
LLX_MODEL.description: A model id of that provider, such as gpt-6-luna. Leave it empty for the one you chose with /login in llx.
